messages:
maria-partnerships: Scheduling quick sync with Mosaic tomorrow 11am PT to close out SSO/SCIM and BYOK/HSM checks for marketplace listing. Drop owners + one-line status. :calendar:
aj-security: I'll own SSO/SAML validation and SCIM attribute mapping. SAML metadata imported, assertion tests green in sandbox. Need Mosaic to confirm 'role' and 'manager' mappings.
mosaic-eng: Mosaic update: SAML ok on our side. SCIM exposes manager and jobTitle; we'll add 'role' as custom attribute by EOD.
mosaic-ops: For BYOK/HSM: vendor HSM supports PKCS#11 key import. We have a BYOK demo working in lab but not yet through Redwood's marketplace harness. Will share a test key id tomorrow.
oliver-sre: Ops note: prepare fallback to platform-managed keys on failed BYOK. I'll draft a 10-step cutover + rollback checklist; need expected recovery time from Mosaic for key import failure.
sophia-marketing: Marketing needs embargo preference and final logo + one-line joint blurb. Recommend 48h embargo. Who owns co-brand review? @liam-legal
liam-legal: I'll review co-branding and draft a short addendum. Need SVG logo and confirmation no customer data in screenshots.
mosaic-eng: We'll push SVG and confirm screenshots scrubbed. Also can provide a 30s admin video clip for rehearsal.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create marketplace release ticket after legal sign-off.
maria-partnerships: Action items: aj-security: finalize SCIM mapping checklist; mosaic-ops: provide test key id + token; oliver-sre: runbook + fallback; liam-legal: draft addendum; sophia-marketing: embargo plan + assets. Meet 15min before rehearsal. :thumbsup:
